scientific_integrity: Derived from an explicit polynomial-generator stationary law, causal covariance semigroup and strictly positive kernel factorization; 622 numerical assertions corroborate but are not used as all-parameter proof. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof concerns a stationary scalar harmonic filter of an autonomous Brownian drive with complete independent rate-beta Poisson resetting of the drive alone, dimensionless diffusion generator partial_yy, and exactly the chosen squared observables. Neither more general forcing, nonlinear filtering, finite-sample inference nor entropy-production identities are established. The relevant prior model and some ordinary moments were known. Equivalent implicit specializations of generic generator methods remain a residual priority risk.
title: A strictly one-way squared-energy response in a harmonically filtered resetting Brownian drive
